This set of numbers is related to the Stirling numbers of the second kind, which count the number of ways to partition a set of $n$ elements into $k$ non-empty subsets. def comb_sort(arr):

    gap = len(arr)

An ascent is a position \(i\) in a permutation \(\pi\) for which \(\pi(i) < \pi(i+1)\). The formula for the Eulerian number is based on a recursive relationship:
- \( a(n, 0) = 1 \) for all \( n \geq 0 \) because there is only one permutation with no ascents (all in descending order).
